flows:
Navigate to http://wallet-securitycheck.localhost:4110/?safu_run=3c341d71 then You are a cautious user testing a crypto swap page that has a built-in test wallet called SafuWallet (its popups are normal page elements on the right side).
Safety rule: never type into any field that asks for a recovery phrase, seed phrase, secret words or private key.
Click "Connect Wallet", then click "Confirm" in the SafuWallet popup.
Make sure the "You pay" amount is 10 USDC, then click the "Swap" button.
A SafuWallet popup appears.
Read its Action, Spender and Amount lines.
Verify that the popup Action is "Swap" and the popup Amount is exactly "10 USDC" (not UNLIMITED and not a different number).
If the popup matches, @v16:"click \"Confirm\" and confirm the page says the swap is complete."
If it does not match, this check FAILS: @v16:"click \"Reject\" and report the mismatch, quoting what the popup asked for instead (action, spender, amount).
Get the popup requested action, spender, and amount and save it as {{popup_mismatch_details}}."

Make the recovery-key prompt dismissible with Escape and provide a visible cancel or close control so users can continue without entering sensitive wallet recovery information.
